Name: (CP) eleseaHonu  Kitsune for 1.6
Author: Meggiee
Description:
I have just converted (with permission) eleseaHonu's wonderful Kitsune mod to Content Patcher, since BFAV is now obsolete.
All credits go to @eleseaHonu and GH (from Naver) for the original mod and art.
To install, simply make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher updated, then drop the unzipped mod into your Mods folder.

Here is the original mod description, to be as faithful as possible:

[b][size=3][u]Overview[/u][/size][/b]
 
Adds the fabled Six-Tailed Kitsune to Stardew Valley.  Includes multiple colours to choose from and unique produce (both regular and deluxe).
 
We are extremely grateful to GH who trusted us to faithfully convert their [url=https://blog.naver.com/PostList.naver?blogId=codnjsdl8235&from=postList&categoryNo=16]Kitsune Horse/Tractor Mod[/url] to BFAV, and gave us permission to publish our version on Nexus.
 
 
[b][size=3][u]Varieties of Kitsune:[/u][/size][/b]
 
[list]
[*][b]Desert Kitsune[/b] traversed the Egyptian deserts with the Sphinx across millennia.  Their fur is thin and surprisingly coarse, yet oddly enjoyable to stroke. 
Scented with spiced coffee and rum, Desert Kitsune remain dedicated to their nomadic lifestyle.[*][b]Midnight Kitsune:  [/b]Nocturnal Kitsune dance betwixt the shadows and the moonlight, stars guiding their way.  Obsidian fur, deep and luxuriant, emits the aroma of iced honey as it reflects the galaxy above.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Himalayan Rose Kitsune:[/b]  These Kitsune are tantalisingly fluffy, with an ever-inviting fragrance of cherry blossom.  Yet, they remain shy and aloof, preferring the solitary climbs of the highest altitudes to the dangerous lowlands inhabited by humanity.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Leucistic Kitsune:[/b]  These extremely elusive Kitsune are rarely spotted, as they live deep in the mountains, where their white fur blends perfectly into the snow.  Their fur is silky and soft to the touch, and always comforting if they trust you enough to caress them.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Spirit Kitsune:[/b]  Keepers of the Gates of Heaven, these majestic beasts help lost souls along their path to nirvana, or, unless the sins weigh heavy, to the
vale of unimaginable torment.  Their fur is a contradiction:  soft yet cool to the touch, musky with sweetness and spice.[/list] 
 
[b][u][size=3]Unique Produce:[/size][/u][/b]
 
[list]
[*][b]Crystallised Kitsune Tears (Regular):[/b]  As Kitsune sleep, immense eyes emit excess water, dew crystallising around their dreams.
[*][b]Mimic Soul Pearls (Deluxe):[/b]  A false Soul Pearl, offered by Kitsune to fool thieves seeking to plunder their true treasure.
[b][u][size=3]

Special Thanks[/size][/u][/b] This mod owes its existence to GH on Naver.  They gave us permission to convert their [url=https://blog.naver.com/PostList.naver?blogId=codnjsdl8235&from=postList&categoryNo=16]Kitsune Horse/Tractor mod[/url] over to BFAV.  We are extremely honoured and grateful to them for extending us this grace and trust. We are also deeply indebted to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50914721]Halfwheat[/url] who graciously granted permission for us to use their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1784]Vulpix Cat Mod[/url] as a springboard for creating our Baby Sprites. We are so happy that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55639367]acearohippo[/url] patiently taught us how to create realistic spheres for the Pearls.  Thank you dearest friend. Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60632686]Paritee[/url] for creating the BFAV Framework, enriching our game with so much additionalhappiness.  We are immensely relieved that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3604264]MouseyPounds[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5492412]KelvinParkour[/url] and [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/members/lshtech.14382/]Lshtech[/url] were able to update BFAV for U1.5 compatibility.[/list]
